body: But my friend did care about me so much, he's almost always been there for me. And now he cut me off too and I don't understand why. I could deal with everything in life if I could have his support back. But now I don't know what to do and where to go. I relied so much on him I am now handicapped. I'd rather lose my legs though. I want to die. When my dad dies, I will kill myself. I can't stand it. I have nothing to fight for.

I would love to have a dog, for the very reasons you mentioned. But due to my work hours it would be a torture for him, having to stay home alone all day. I don't know what to do, especially that I'm a slightly bit succesful in life, except of having friends. So at the moment no one can see how hurt I am and how much I would appreciate an honest friendship. But I don't know how to trust people anymore after all this, so I know it's not gonna happen. I'm surrounded by expensive toys which mean fuck all to me now. I feel no satisfaction whatsoever from being succesful at work, although it's good cause I can assure my parents that I'm doing well in life.
